title: Aufrüsten: from cold to departure
intro: A cold-start service finds the BR 145 dark; a timetable service loads it with no cab occupied ('Kein Führerstand besetzt'), SiFa isolated and its cut-off valves closed. The order: Cab 1, machine room, Cab 2, Cab 1 again.

steps.text: Loco under the wire; at least one brake applied (red square with a black dot).
Battery (Batterie) on; every breaker on this wall closed, switches normal, auxiliary controls off.
Headlights as required.
Fahrschalter at Off; reverser key in, and keep PARK BRK up: the key is held only while it is.
Richtungsschalter to V (Forward); this occupies the cab.
Signal and instrument lights on, AFB off; ease the direct brake to 0.5 bar C-pressure or less.
Parking brake on (light lit).
Close every LSS and MSS breaker in the HBG 1, FML 2 and HBG 2 cabinets.
SiFa, LZB and PZB isolation switches to normal.
Open the SiFa and LZB/PZB cut-off valves; the pantograph cut-off valve open.
Leave the driver's brake cut-off valve closed, as the manual's start-up wants.
Cab 2: breakers closed, switches normal, lights as required, direct brake at Hold, test the horn pedal.
Cab 2: air compressor switch on, signal and instrument lights on; walk back to Cab 1.
Raise the pantograph, close the Hauptschalter, switch the air compressor on.
Train number: MTD [4] Zug-BeSy, [2] Zug-/Tf.Nr., [E] for the driver ID; set up GSM-R.
Führerbremsventil at Running; the brake pipe stays at 5 bar.
Richtungsschalter to M (Neutral): still 5 bar; back to V.
Electric brake handle to Decouple (in the cab), brake pipe down 0.8 bar, release.
MTD W, Prüfen, soft key 5 'BrR 2 Ein'; after the HSM change repeat Decouple, 0.8 bar, release.
Apply and release the direct brake, watching the C-pressure gauge.
PZB/LZB test with a direction set and the train brake released: MTD [4] ZugBesy, [8] Prüfen.
It shows the MFA lamps, two emergency applications that empty and refill the pipe, LZB 1200 / 1000 / 120 / 115.
SiFa test: direct brake on, hold the pedal (Q) 35 s: light at 30 s, 'Sifa' three times, then emergency brake.
Direct brake on, release the parking brake, machine room and cab lights off, test the horn.
Rolling test: release all brakes, a little power, roll a few metres, power to 0, stop on the direct brake.
Parking and hand brakes on, NBÜ/ep at 0, fill the brake pipe to 5 bar.
First wagon released: kick a brake shoe (it moves) or hammer a wheel (a bright, long ring).
Richtungsschalter to M cuts the brake valve off: at most 0.5 bar lost in 60 s (0.3 passenger).
Back to V, let the pipe reach 5.0 bar, then brake to 4.2 bar or lower.
Walk one side: brakes applied, couplers tight, hoses joined, cocks open, hand brakes off.
Rear: angle cock closed, hose and coupler on their hooks, Zg 2 tail signals present.
Release to 5.0 bar; walk the other side: brakes released, brake mode and load as the Wagenliste says.
Continuity: open the rear angle cock 15 s; the last wagon brakes, then releases.
BRA from the loco's brake mode: R = 9, P = 4, G = 2.
BRH: convert the Brh % with the BR 145 ZDE sheet (76–95 % gives 080).
ZL: length rounded up to tens (533 m = 54). VMZ: the formation limit, else the timetable speed.
MTD [4] ZugBesy, [1] ZDE: BRA, BRH, ZL, VMZ, [E] twice, then hold PZB Wachsam a second.
Check: hold Wachsam and Frei together; [85] lights and the MFA shows the data.
At V: parking brake off, Führerbremsventil to Running, release the direct brake.
Fahrschalter through Min upwards; or AFB on, Fahrschalter back to 0, set the speed.
On the move: SiFa reset, PZB Wachsam, Frei, Befehl 40.
steps.tca: Gear lever / ENG 2 / ENG 1 / Round aux

steps.text: Abrüsten: radio off or mode C, direct brake to 0.5 bar, parking brake on, sand both ways.
Open the Hauptschalter, lower the pantograph, Richtungsschalter to 0, reverser key out.
Isolate SiFa, close windows and doors, lights off in both cabs and the machine room, battery off.

notes: Reverser stuck: keep PARK BRK up (the key is held only while it is) and the Fahrschalter at Off. The Fahrschalter moves only at V.
'Kein Führerstand besetzt' stays: key in and a direction set. The profile drives the front (F) cab only.
SiFa or PZB will not come on: open their cut-off valves in the machine room; the aux squares only set the isolation switches.
AFB brakes freight at 0.3 m/s²; do not let it brake and release in quick succession, the distributors can stick.
PZB isolated: 100 km/h enforced (50 km/h allowed from 2012). Isolate LZB light or at Brh 65 % or less.
source: Source: BR 145 Expert Manual, Version 1.0, Train Sim Germany
